criterion: TRAPPED iff the completion rate (trap_v2.rate_estimator; default: uncached prefill tokens/s over the post-burst window vs E0a's all-miss rate) is within +-rate_tolerance of its all-miss reference AND the session backlog slope > slope_frac*(lambda-lambda_miss) [and lambda > lambda_miss]; DRAINING iff slope<0; RECOVERED iff hit > recovered_hit_above and the backlog (trap_v2.recovered_backlog_metric; default outstanding = requests in flight + gate queue) < recovered_backlog_below at the end. PASS per lambda: BURST trapped AND NOBURST good AND CAPPED recovered in >= pass_fraction_min of the seeds.
